Run `rmarkdown::render("fig5/fig5.Rmd")` from the repository root.

This document runs both components of Figure 5: the virus-host overview
(original Figure 5) and the cross-host association analysis (original Figure 6).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
figure_dir <- normalizePath(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), winslash = "/")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = FALSE,
                      eval = params$run_analysis, error = FALSE)

run_panel <- function(panel_dir, script_name) {
  old_dir <- setwd(file.path(figure_dir, "panels", panel_dir))
  on.exit(setwd(old_dir), add = TRUE)
  source(script_name, echo = TRUE, chdir = FALSE)
}
```

## Figure 5A: virus-host overview

```{r figure-5a}
run_panel(
  "fig.5a_virus_host_overview",
  "figure5a_virus_host_overview.R"
)
```

## Figure 5B: cross-host associations

```{r figure-5b}
run_panel(
  "fig.5b_cross_host_associations",
  "figure5b_cross_host_associations.R"
)
```

sessionInfo()
